In human… 33030946 hypoxia sensitive commd1 integrates signaling cellular metabolism human Summary Hypoxia augments inflammatory responses and osteoclastogenesis by i Hypoxia‐Sensitive COMMD1 Integrates Signaling and Cellular Metabolism in Human Macrophages and Suppresses Osteoclastogenesis Summary Hypoxia augments inflammatory responses and osteoclastogenesis by incompletely understood mechanisms. We identified COMMD1 as a cell‐intrinsic negative regulator of osteoclastogenesis that is suppressed by hypoxia. In human macrophages, COMMD1 restrained induction of NF‐&kgr;B signaling and a transcription factor E2F1‐dependent metabolic pathway by the cytokine RANKL. Downregulation of COMMD1 protein expression by hypoxia augmented RANKL‐induced expression of inflammatory and E2F1 target genes and downstream osteoclastogenesis.
